question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"sized."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Sized"** means measured or evaluated for a particular purpose. (बताए गए आकार का; आकार वाला)

 
 
• **Example**: *She has a medium-**sized**__ flat.*
 
 
 
• This option is the most appropriate because it fits the context of the blank.
 
• **"Assessed"** could potentially work, but **"sized"** is a more precise and fitting word.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

Amla tree is __considered__ to be thousands of years old. It is called aamaleki and dhaatri in Sanskrit. Its botanical name is Emblica Officinalis. The amla tree is a medium __**sized**__ tree with citrus fruits. It is found almost everywhere in India ______ (3) ______ for some very high mountainous regions. It is found ______ (4) ______ in Madhya Pradesh. The leaves are very small and have a close ______ (5) ______ to those of Gulmohar. The amla tree has slender branches which grow upwards and surround the trees on all sides.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Sorted" **means organized or arranged in a particular order. (किसी विशेष क्रम में व्यवस्थित)
 
• **Option 3: "Assessed"** means evaluated or judged. (मूल्यांकन या निर्णय किया गया)
 
• **Option 4: "Weighed"** means measured the weight of something. (किसी चीज़ का वजन मापा)
